name: huber_loss_out
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::huber_loss.out(Tensor self, Tensor target, int reduction=Mean, float delta=1.0, *, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!). Computes Huber loss into the keyword-only out tensor, mutates that buffer, and returns the same tensor object. Tests cover zero-sized and regular tensors, none, mean, and sum reduction, multiple positive delta values, correctly shaped output storage identity, wrong-shape resize, unsafe output-cast rejection, and invalid negative delta rejection.
